title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing CS degree, experience in C++, C#, Java, or Python
description: Work on real-world engineering projects alongside industry mentors at Microsoft, developing global software solutions.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from eligible countries worldwide.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, Stipend, Airfare, Health Insurance)
qualification: Completed Bachelor's degree or equivalent, demonstrated academic excellence and leadership
description: Enables graduate students and young professionals to undertake master's or PhD studies and research at U.S. universities.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to early-career developers with strong JavaScript and frontend technology skills worldwide.
qualification: Proficiency in HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and Vue.js or React
description: Help design and build interactive user interfaces for GitLab's open core DevOps platform in an all-remote workplace.

title: Google Summer of Code 2025
eligibility: Student developers and open-source beginners aged 18 and older globally.
qualification: Basic programming skills and interest in contributing to open-source software projects
description: A global, online program designed to bring new contributors into open source software development organizations.

title: Associate Product Analyst
eligibility: 0-2 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or product management.
qualification: Bachelor's degree, proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools
description: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to conduct user research, analyze platform data, and drive product growth.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with an interest in learning programming and computer science principles.
description: An entry-level course teaching foundational computer science concepts, algorithmic thinking, and languages like C, Python, and SQL.
